ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 30% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous region across the right lobe and central area; high-contrast white mottling and large irregular white patches concentrated on the left lobe spanning from the mid-section to the outer tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography; high frequency of sharp peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the median notch extending to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme left and right tips; scattered individual white spots across dark pigmentation regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the light-pigmented region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations and associated scarring at the distal points of both lobes; significant serration suggests possible previous physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the predominantly white-mottled left lobe and the predominantly dark right lobe.
